name: happy-idle
intent: Expressive in-place idle loop with repeated light pelvis/leg bounce, broad side-to-side head and upper-body sway, and low relaxed arms.

phases.label: opening-side lean unwinds toward centered stance
opposite-side sway builds to its visible peak
peak releases and returns through centered stance
opening-side lean rebuilds to close the loop

weightTransfer: Using the pelvis as a center-of-mass proxy, lateral motion shifts from -X/left at f32 (-0.0162 MLL) to +X/right at f53 (+0.0239 MLL), returns near center at f63 (+0.0030 MLL), and closes the loop near the opening lateral position at f88 (+0.0013 MLL). Support foot is not asserted.
bodyMechanics: Rhythmic pelvis rise/fall is layered with slower lateral pelvis travel. Head/neck excursion is larger than chest motion while the arms remain low and relatively relaxed. Across f32 → f48 → f54 → f60, the large sway builds to the clearest visible head/upper-body lean, continues into the deepest pelvis compression, then recovers toward centered stance. This describes overlapping coordinated motion only; no fixed causal joint activation order is asserted.

recommended: layered vertical bounce and lateral sway
pronounced head/upper-body sway with low relaxed arms
